summary: DESIGN CONFIRMED — PLAN.md is written and ready to execute. 18 steps across 4 phases, every one citing the design nodes it implements (verified: 18/18 steps, 0 unknown citations, 0 steps without a chart-node citation, so the gap protocol's stale-step tracking works). Phase 1 is the mechanical spotlight and is fully headless with seven hard gates - it can run autonomously. Phases 2 and 3 are the shader, the light layer and the reveal; they need iteration against a rendered frame and a higher effort level. Phase 4 is the tuning tool. Phase 5, the film pipeline, is deliberately NOT in this plan: Q239=a ships it as a second deliverable after Spotlight. Two things to know: the rename active -> spotlight touches @export_storage, so gate G1.3 asserts the save migration; and Q84 (dim_target on the style) contradicts Q168 (dim_target in settings) - the plan resolves to Q84 as the later, more specific answer and tells the executor to file a gap if that reading is wrong. Open the canvas and hit Confirm if you want version 1 frozen.
